question: National Defence Academy is located at:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khadakwasla (Pune)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Defence Academy (NDA) is located at **Khadakwasla, Pune, Maharashtra**.
 
• The NDA is the joint services academy of the Indian Armed Forces where cadets of the three services, the Army, the Navy, and the Air Force train together before they go on to respective service academies for further pre-commission training.
 
• The foundation stone of NDA was laid by the then Prime Minister of India, Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru, on 6 October 1949.
 
• The academy was formally inaugurated on 7 December 1954, with an aim to train young officers and instill in them the values of duty, honor, and country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Training Programs at NDA:**

 
 
• The training program at NDA includes academic education, outdoor training, and physical fitness training which spans over three years.
 
• Cadets are awarded a Bachelor's degree in Arts, Science, or Computer Science upon successful completion of their training.
 
 
 
• **Admission Process:**
 
 
• Admission to NDA is based on a written exam conducted by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), followed by an extensive interview by the Services Selection Board (SSB).
 
• Only male candidates are eligible to apply for NDA, and they must be between 16.5 to 19.5 years of age.
 
 
 
• **Notable Alumni:**
 
 
• Many prominent military leaders and officers of the Indian Armed Forces have graduated from NDA, including former Chiefs of the Indian Army, Navy, and Air Force.
 
• Some notable alumni include General Bipin Rawat (former Chief of Defence Staff), Admiral Sunil Lanba (former Chief of Naval Staff), and Air Chief Marshal R.K.S. Bhadauria (former Chief of Air Staff).
